summary: US stocks rose (S&P +0.6%, NDX +1.2%) on AI/chip strength and Russia-Ukraine talks, with Meta, TI, IBM and Lam beating after hours. The backdrop stays hawkish: 10y ~5.13%, Fed hikes priced, Brent ~$110 on Gulf tension.

ES.why: S&P 500 rose 0.6% on AI/chip strength and Russia-Ukraine talk hopes; earnings after the bell (Meta, TI, IBM) beat, but 5.1% 10y yields and $110 Brent cap it.
ES.risk: Gulf escalation headlines or a jump in yields/oil reverses the risk-on tone.

NQ.why: Nasdaq 100 +1.2% led by chips; Meta (+3.5-6%), Lam and TI beat after hours. Leveraged funds at 74th pct, not crowded. Hawkish Fed and 5%+ yields limit conviction.
NQ.risk: Embassy/Hormuz escalation or a yield spike toward Fed hike pricing for Oct 28.

YM.why: Dow +0.7% with broad participation and IBM beating after hours; offset by high yields, oil and a hawkish Fed backdrop.
YM.risk: Oil spike on Gulf news or rising yields hitting cyclicals.

RTY.why: Small caps lagged (+0.3%) with 10y yields at 5.13% and Fed hikes priced; rate-sensitive index lacks sponsorship.
RTY.risk: A drop in yields or soft jobless claims would favour a bullish turn.

NKD.why: Nikkei rebounded ~1% on AI/chip names and US tech beats add support; leveraged funds near the 12th pct (short-leaning). $110 oil and BOJ hike talk temper it.
NKD.risk: Hot Japan CPI (Fri 10:30 Sydney), hawkish BOJ talk or a yen spike on intervention.

6J.why: USD/JPY flat near 158.2: BOJ's Himino sounded hawkish and intervention risk is live, but 5% US yields, Fed hikes and $110 oil keep the yen weak.
6J.risk: Japanese intervention or hot Japan CPI (yen up); a break higher in US yields (yen down).

6E.why: Euro lagged the majors as French 10y yields hit 5% on fiscal worries ahead of Friday's Moody's review; ECB hawkish talk only partly offsets.
6E.risk: Easing of French fiscal stress or stronger euro-area PMIs Friday.

6B.why: UK CPI beat at 3.5% with hot core and services, firming BoE November hike bets; sterling rose modestly but lacked follow-through.
6B.risk: Dovish remarks from Governor Bailey tonight or a broad dollar bid.

6A.why: AUD led the majors (~0.703) after RBA's Hauser called inflation 'materially worse' and Goldman moved to a November hike call; risk-on equities help.
6A.risk: Risk-off from Gulf escalation or RBA pushback on November hike pricing.

ZN.why: Fed hiking cycle, $110 Brent and a 20y auction at its highest yield since 1986 keep pressure on Treasuries; 10y ~5.13%, roughly flat on the day.
ZN.risk: Flight to safety on a Gulf escalation or a weak jobless claims print.

GC.why: Gold near $4,120-4,135, mixed after a run of losses: Fed hike bets and higher yields weigh while Middle East risk supports.
GC.risk: A decisive move in yields or a major Gulf escalation picks the side.

CL.why: WTI slipped despite a big EIA draw and a Saudi oilfield drone attack; Russia-Ukraine talks offset Hormuz closure and embassy-departure risk.
CL.risk: Confirmed Gulf supply disruption (bullish) or concrete peace-talk progress (bearish).
